    FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      "sr_store_sk" AS store_sk,
      sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS sales_price,
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS profit,
      sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
      "sr_net_loss" AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns
  ) AS "salesreturns"
  CROSS JOIN date_dim
  CROSS JOIN store
  WHERE
    date_sk = "d_date_sk"
    AND d_date BETWEEN TRY_CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND TRY_CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE)

      cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,

      cs_ext_sales_price AS "sales_price",
      cs_net_profit AS profit,

      cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
      "cr_net_loss" AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
  ) AS salesreturns
  CROSS JOIN date_dim
  CROSS JOIN "catalog_page"
  WHERE
    "date_sk" = "d_date_sk"
    AND d_date BETWEEN TRY_CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND TRY_CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE)
    AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  GROUP BY

), wsr AS (
  SELECT
    web_site_id,

  FROM (

      ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,

      ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
      ws_net_profit AS profit,
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS return_amt,

      ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,

      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS sales_price,

FILE_FORMAT=() AS
SELECT
  sr_store_sk,
  d.d_year,
  SUM(sr_return_amt) AS returned
FROM store_returns AS sr
JOIN date_dim AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
WHERE
  d.d_year IN (2000, 2001)
GROUP BY
  sr_store_sk,
  d.d_year;
INSERT INTO l18_returns
SELECT
  sr_store_sk,
  2002,
  SUM(sr_return_amt)
FROM store_returns AS sr
JOIN date_dim AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
WHERE
  d.d_year = 2002
GROUP BY
  sr_store_sk;
SELECT
  sr_store_sk,
  d_year,
  ROUND(returned, 2) AS returned
FROM l18_returns
ORDER BY
  sr_store_sk NULLS FIRST,
  d_year NULLS FIRST

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS l19_stage;
CREATE TABLE l19_stage (
  i_item_sk INT,
  i_brand VARCHAR,
  first_sold INT,
  n BIGINT
)
FILE_FORMAT=();
INSERT OVERWRITE INTO l19_stage
SELECT
  i.i_item_sk,
  i.i_brand,
  MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk),
  COUNT(*)
FROM store_sales AS ss
JOIN item AS i
  ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
WHERE
  i.i_item_sk <= 80
GROUP BY
  i.i_item_sk,
  i.i_brand;
INSERT OVERWRITE INTO l19_stage
SELECT
  i_item_sk,
  UPPER(i_brand),
  first_sold,
  n
FROM l19_stage
WHERE
  n >= 100;
SELECT
  s.*,
  COALESCE(d.d_date, TRY_CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)) AS first_date
FROM l19_stage AS s
LEFT JOIN date_dim AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = s.first_sold
ORDER BY
  s.i_item_sk NULLS FIRST

  v AS value
FROM (

    ss_store_sk,
    STR_TO_MAP(
      CONCAT(
        'tickets:',
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number),
        ',items:',
        SUM(ss_quantity),
        ',customers:',
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk)
      ),
      ',',
      ':'
    ) AS m
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE
    ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2451545 AND 2451550
  GROUP BY
    ss_store_sk
) AS t
LATERAL VIEW
FLATTEN(m) e AS k, v
ORDER BY
  ss_store_sk NULLS FIRST,
  metric NULLS FIRST

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS d10_v_item_rank AS
SELECT
  i_item_sk,
  i_brand,
  i_current_price,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY i_brand
    ORDER BY i_current_price DESC NULLS LAST, i_item_sk NULLS FIRST
  ) AS rn,
  TO_CHAR(CAST(i_rec_start_date AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-mm') AS since
FROM item
WHERE
  NOT i_rec_start_date IS NULL AND NOT i_current_price IS NULL
